requirements.text: on every code version and for either flag value, a normal 300-share order with three routing opportunities of 100 shares is sent as exactly three child orders of 100 shares, all 300 shares are executed, and the fourth routing opportunity sends nothing.

after any sequence of events, a routing opportunity for an existing parent sends exactly one child order for the available liquidity capped at the parent's shares not yet sent, and nothing when that is zero or the parent does not exist.
on every code version, for every flag value, every parent order and every sequence of events, the cumulative shares sent in child orders for a parent never exceed its quantity.
once a parent order has been executed completely, no event makes the router send another child order for it.
the shares executed for a parent order never exceed its quantity, so no execution is left without a customer order to match it.
the router's cumulative executed quantity for every parent order equals the shares actually executed in its child orders.
